title: Meet Time Personal Best Delta
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swim:meet event_name=* finish_time_seconds=*
| stats min(finish_time_seconds) as best_time, latest(finish_time_seconds) as latest_time by event_name
| eval delta_seconds=round(latest_time-best_time,2)
| sort delta_seconds
| table event_name best_time latest_time delta_seconds
description: Compares latest swim meet finish times against personal bests for each event.
value: Race-day deltas show whether training cycles are converting to faster times when it counts.
implementation: Log `event_name` and `finish_time_seconds` for every meet and review deltas after each competition.
visualization: Table of events with best, latest, and delta seconds.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how your most recent race times compare with your personal bests.
